subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should Control UI ship built-in math rendering now, and if yes which default, library, and sanitizer boundary should be accepted?
rationale: The feature is useful and source-proven missing, but the viable fixes add a public UI behavior/config surface plus a math-rendering dependency and sanitizer changes that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor default-off Control UI math rendering
options.body: Accept a narrow built-in renderer, likely default-off or explicitly gated, with focused tests and real browser proof.

options.title: Defer until sanitizer/dependency design is settled
options.body: Keep this canonical issue open while maintainers decide between KaTeX, MathJax, MathML-oriented output, or another safe rendering approach.

options.title: Reject core support for now
options.body: Close the feature direction only if maintainers decide math rendering should stay outside the Control UI core surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-off Control UI math rendering
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow built-in renderer, likely default-off or explicitly gated, with focused tests and real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work touched the same Control UI markdown rendering path and the decision needs product/security judgment.
